name: 72110 · Morrilton, AR
findings: ZIP 72110 (Morrilton) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72110 (Morrilton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72110 (Morrilton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
